check("climb_stairs(1)", lambda: climb_stairs(1), 1)
check("climb_stairs(2)", lambda: climb_stairs(2), 2)
check("climb_stairs(5)", lambda: climb_stairs(5), 8)
check("climb_stairs(3)", lambda: climb_stairs(3), 3)
check("climb_stairs(4)", lambda: climb_stairs(4), 5)
check("climb_stairs(10)", lambda: climb_stairs(10), 89)
check("climb_stairs(30) without exponential recursion", lambda: climb_stairs(30), 1346269)

check("rob([1, 2, 3, 1])", lambda: rob([1, 2, 3, 1]), 4)
check("rob([2, 7, 9, 3, 1])", lambda: rob([2, 7, 9, 3, 1]), 12)
check("rob([])", lambda: rob([]), 0)
check("rob(single house)", lambda: rob([5]), 5)
check("rob(two houses: take the bigger)", lambda: rob([2, 1]), 2)
check("rob(skip two houses in a row)", lambda: rob([2, 1, 1, 2]), 4)
check("rob(all zeros)", lambda: rob([0, 0, 0]), 0)
check("rob(both ends)", lambda: rob([10, 1, 1, 10]), 20)

check("coin_change([1, 2, 5], 11)", lambda: coin_change([1, 2, 5], 11), 3)
check("coin_change([2], 3)", lambda: coin_change([2], 3), -1)
check("coin_change([], 0)", lambda: coin_change([], 0), 0)
check("coin_change([1], 0) needs no coins", lambda: coin_change([1], 0), 0)
check("coin_change greedy trap: [1, 3, 4], 6", lambda: coin_change([1, 3, 4], 6), 2)
check("coin_change(unsorted coins)", lambda: coin_change([5, 2, 1], 11), 3)
check("coin_change(one exact coin)", lambda: coin_change([7], 7), 1)
check("coin_change(no combination fits)", lambda: coin_change([2, 5], 3), -1)
check("coin_change(larger amount)", lambda: coin_change([186, 419, 83, 408], 6249), 20)

check("length_of_lis([10, 9, 2, 5, 3, 7, 101, 18])", lambda: length_of_lis([10, 9, 2, 5, 3, 7, 101, 18]), 4)
check("length_of_lis([0, 1, 0, 3, 2, 3])", lambda: length_of_lis([0, 1, 0, 3, 2, 3]), 4)
check("length_of_lis([7, 7, 7])", lambda: length_of_lis([7, 7, 7]), 1)
check("length_of_lis(empty list)", lambda: length_of_lis([]), 0)
check("length_of_lis(single value)", lambda: length_of_lis([5]), 1)
check("length_of_lis(strictly decreasing)", lambda: length_of_lis([5, 4, 3, 2, 1]), 1)
check("length_of_lis(already increasing)", lambda: length_of_lis([1, 2, 3, 4]), 4)
check("length_of_lis(negative values)", lambda: length_of_lis([-3, -1, -2, 0]), 3)
check("length_of_lis(subsequence is not contiguous)", lambda: length_of_lis([3, 10, 2, 1, 20]), 3)

check("longest_common_subsequence('abcde', 'ace')", lambda: longest_common_subsequence("abcde", "ace"), 3)
check("longest_common_subsequence('abc', 'def')", lambda: longest_common_subsequence("abc", "def"), 0)
check("longest_common_subsequence(empty string)", lambda: longest_common_subsequence("", "abc"), 0)
check("longest_common_subsequence(identical strings)", lambda: longest_common_subsequence("abc", "abc"), 3)
check("longest_common_subsequence(order matters)", lambda: longest_common_subsequence("abc", "cba"), 1)
check("longest_common_subsequence(repeated letters)", lambda: longest_common_subsequence("aab", "azb"), 2)
check("longest_common_subsequence(one match out of repeats)", lambda: longest_common_subsequence("bl", "yby"), 1)
check("longest_common_subsequence(longer strings)", lambda: longest_common_subsequence("oxcpqrsvwf", "shmtulqrypy"), 2)
